Flow.description:
When a user with the "Flow Trigger" set to "Quarterly Tiering" changes the Account Type, create a case in these scenarios: Moved from Starter to Core (assign to new support rep) Moved from Premier to AGP (assign to previous support rep) Moved from Premier to Starter (assign to previous support rep) Moved from AGP to Premier (assign to previous support rep) Moved from AGP to Starter (assign to previous support rep)
S3P-1432 - Created, merged from flow from S3P-1143 and S3P-1145.

formulas.description: Returns the former Support Rep for all type changes except for Starter to Core which returns the new Support Rep.
formulas.name: Formula_CaseOwner

formulas.description: Final formula description, combines smaller formulas to update the description based on the different type change scenarios
formulas.name: Formula_Description
formulas.expression:
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.Type}, "Starter"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type}, "Core") ), {!Formula_Description_TierChange} & BR() & "Please reach out to this agent to introduce yourself as their new Support Rep.",
IF( OR( AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type}, "Starter")), AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP Premier"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type}, "Starter")) ), {!Formula_Description_TierChange} & BR() & BR() & {!Formula_Description_EmailNotice} & BR() & BR() & {!Formula_Description_ResultsFieldNote} & BR() & {!Formula_Description_ProAdmin},
IF( OR( AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP Premier"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP")), AND(ISPICKVAL({!$Record__Prior.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Type}, "Accelerated-AGP Premier")) ), {!Formula_Description_TierChange} & BR() & BR() & {!Formula_Description_EmailNotice} & BR() & BR() & {!Formula_Description_ResultsFieldNote},
"" )))

formulas.description: Used in Description if an email is sent for that change type.
formulas.name: Formula_Description_EmailNotice
formulas.expression: "When you close this case, an email will be sent to the Primary Contact on this Account to notify them of the change. If, for some reason, an email should not be sent upon closure, please check the 'Do not send automated email' field before closing."

formulas.name: Formula_Description_ProAdmin
formulas.expression: "Before closing this case, make sure you COMPLETE THESE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTIONS IN PRO:"& BR() & "- Remove Promos"& BR() & "- Move Account Classification"& BR() & "- Change Prices"& BR() & "- Remove Services"

formulas.name: Formula_Description_ResultsFieldNote
formulas.expression: "PLEASE ADD DETAILS ABOUT THE TIER MOVEMENT in the Results field."

formulas.description: First line used in Description, shows the tier changed from and to.
formulas.name: Formula_Description_TierChange
formulas.expression: "This case was created because the Agency was tiered from " & TEXT({!$Record__Prior.Type}) & " to " & TEXT({!$Record.Type}) & "."

textTemplates.name: AGPToPremier_CaseDescription
textTemplates.text:
This case was created because the agent has been tiered up from AGP to Premier.


When you close this case, an email will be sent to the Primary Contact on this Account to notify them of the change and introducing their new support rep. If, for some reason, an email should not be sent upon closure, please check the "Do not send automated email" field before closing.

textTemplates.name: AGPToStarter_CaseDescription
textTemplates.text:
This case was created because the agent has been removed from AGP tier.


When you close this case, an email will be sent to the Primary Contact on this Account to notify them of the change. If, for some reason, an email should not be sent upon closure, please check the "Do not send automated email" field before closing. 


Before closing this case, PLEASE ADD DETAILS ABOUT THE TIER MOVEMENT in the Results field and make sure you COMPLETE THESE ADMINISTRATIVE ACTIONS IN PRO:

- Remove Promos

- Move Account Classification

- Change Prices

- Remove Services
